workspace.description: The workspace whose setup it is, by the slug list_workspaces answered; leave it out where the member belongs to one workspace alone.

repository.description: The repository whose run actions to edit, as owner/name, under any casing of its name.

actionId.description: The action to change or remove, by the id read_sandbox_setup answered; leave it out to add one, which then needs a label and a command.

remove.description: true to remove the action actionId names; nothing else given is then read.

label.description: What the Run menu and the action's Terminal tab call it.

command.description: The bash it runs from the repository's checkout, with the workspace's environment variables, such as pnpm dev.

icon.description: The icon it wears in the Run menu, one emoji or one Lucide icon by its kebab-case name in a color or none, such as rocket; null for the menu's own.

isDefault.description: true to make it the repository's default, which the Run button runs, so no other action is; false to make it no longer the default.

position.description: Its place in the list after the edit, from 0, a place past the end being the last; an added action goes last and a changed one stays where it stood where left out.
